caption:
Lips First

Yoga has been part of my life for twenty years.
Most mornings, I practise alone in my hotel room;
on slower ones, I go to a studio.

I never arrive bare-faced.
In that long mirror, a face without colour looks a little lonely.
Still, sweat and yogawear call for a lighter hand.

So I begin with the lips:
a long-wearing shade that warms the skin.
I press the same colour onto my cheeks and lids,
blending it with my fingertips.
A trace of red liner at the lashes, a soft pink brow,
and five minutes later, my face looks rested again.

On casual days, lipstick is often the first thing we skip.
Perhaps it should be the first thing we reach for.
